# IEditCommand&lt;TPixel&gt;

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public interface IEditCommand<TPixel>
```

One reversible edit over an [`IEditSurface<TPixel>`](Nfty.Core.Editing.IEditSurface-1.md). Apply captures enough to Undo.

**Type parameters**

- `TPixel` - The pixel the target surface stores.

## Methods

### Apply(IEditSurface&lt;TPixel&gt;) { #m-apply-nfty-core-editing-ieditsurface-0 }

```csharp
public abstract bool Apply(IEditSurface<TPixel> surface);
```

Applies the edit and returns whether it changed any pixel — a redundant edit (nothing to fill, or painting the value a pixel already holds) returns false so history can skip an empty entry. Re-applying (redo) reports the same verdict the first Apply did.

**Parameters**

- `surface` (`IEditSurface<TPixel>`) - The surface to edit.

**Returns.** True when the edit changed anything.

### Undo(IEditSurface&lt;TPixel&gt;) { #m-undo-nfty-core-editing-ieditsurface-0 }

```csharp
public abstract void Undo(IEditSurface<TPixel> surface);
```

Restores what `Apply` overwrote.

**Parameters**

- `surface` (`IEditSurface<TPixel>`) - The surface to restore.
